items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: Well, that's Cattrall, Herbert Hall, Dan Taylor.

ctx.x: Well, that's Cattrall, Herbert Hall, Dan Taylor.
Everybody was one of the heart. Save him a heart. Maybe someday in heaven or more. There's only more for that kind of love. Angels won't blame her. They told her many of the heart. Blue Blue Blue.
